entries.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID
entries.description: The 10-digit customer id of the Google Ads account Brain A reads. Not a secret.
howToGet: In Google Ads, the customer id is at the top of the page next to the account name, as 123-456-7890. Dashes are fine.

entries.name: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
entries.description: The developer token Google Ads issues to a manager account for API access. A new token reads test accounts only; reading the store's real account needs Basic access, which Google grants on application.
howToGet: Sign in to a Google Ads manager account (create one if the store has none) and open Admin > API Center.
Accept the terms and copy the developer token. Apply for Basic access there so it can read a production account.
Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID
entries.description: The 10-digit customer id of the manager account the connected user reaches the store's account through. Leave it unset when the user signs in to the store's account directly.
howToGet: In the manager account, copy its customer id from the top of the page.

entries.name: GOOGLE_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
entries.description: The refresh token from connecting a Google account with access to the Google Ads account, with the adwords scope only. Google Ads has no read-only scope, so give that user Read only access in Google Ads; Brain A only ever sends searches. It is a separate connection from the other Google connectors, because each one stops if its token holds any scope beyond its own.
howToGet: Turn on the Google Ads API in the Google Cloud project that owns the OAuth client.
In Google Ads, open Admin > Access and security and add a Google account with Read only access (a user made for Brain A is best).

Have that account connect to the instance's OAuth client with access_type=offline, prompt=consent and only the scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords. Google's OAuth 2.0 Playground with the client's own credentials works (add https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground as an authorized redirect URI).
The connector stops if the token holds any other scope, so don't add one.
Copy the refresh token straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
